description: This file contains classes and functions for processing conversation transcripts, including user and assistant transcript processors, handling various frame types, and managing event handlers within a speech/text processing pipeline.

classes.name: BaseTranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for processing conversation transcript messages and updates.

classes.name: UserTranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Processes user transcription frames into timestamped conversation messages.

classes.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Processes assistant TTS and LLM thought frames into timestamped messages, handling aggregation and state management.

classes.name: TranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Factory class managing user and assistant transcript processors with shared event handling, including deprecated status.

methods.name: BaseTranscriptProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the base processor with an empty message store and registers an event handler.

methods.name: UserTranscriptProcessor.process_frame
methods.description: Processes frames into user messages if frame is a TranscriptionFrame.

methods.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes assistant processor with aggregation state, including optional thought processing.

methods.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor._emit_aggregated_assistant_text
methods.description: Aggregates and emits combined assistant TTS text fragments as a message.

methods.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor._emit_aggregated_thought
methods.description: Aggregates and emits combined LLM thought text fragments as a thought message.

methods.name: AssistantTranscriptProcessor.process_frame
methods.description: Handles various frame types to manage aggregation of assistant speech and thoughts, emitting messages accordingly.

methods.name: TranscriptProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the factory managing user and assistant processors, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: TranscriptProcessor.user
methods.description: Returns the user transcript processor, creating it if necessary, and applies event handlers.

methods.name: TranscriptProcessor.assistant
methods.description: Returns the assistant transcript processor, creating it if necessary, and applies event handlers.

methods.name: TranscriptProcessor.event_handler
methods.description: Registers an event handler for both user and assistant processors.
